newsitem.title: SPAIN: Man shot in Basque guerrilla attack.
newsitem.headline: Man shot in Basque guerrilla attack.

text.p: A man was shot and seriously wounded in northern Spain on Thursday in what a government official said was clearly a guerrilla attack.
Police said a gunman walked up to the man and shot him in the forehead at close range. The gunman then fled.
"It is clear that this was a terrorist attack," said local authority official Roman Sudupe.
A Basque government spokesman said the victim had not been a member of the security forces, a common target for ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) separatists.
Police said they could not confirm whether the attack had been the work of ETA, which has killed some 800 people since 1968 in its campaign for an independent Basque state.
